A '''jukebox''' plays [[music disc]]s, as in vanilla. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is crafted with a [[Hepatizon Alloy]] instead of a diamond.

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Natural generation ===
One jukebox generates in the inhabited house of [[abandoned village]]s, where it plays "Dry Hands" when a player approaches.
